title: Fritz Pauer, the band's director, and the year of the move
summary: Pauer was pianist, Johannes Fehring musical director, and Farmer became a resident in 1968.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: No, he was the pianist in the band.
The musical director was a guy named Johannes Fehring.
What year was that that you finally made the decision to move to Europe?
This was in the sixties, say like around ’66, around that time.
That early? ‘Cause I think it’s showing ’68 in most references.

It says ’68 because what happened was that I still had my place over here, but I had sublet it, and in ’68, I let it go. That’s when I started saying that’s the time I really became a resident in Europe.
